profiles.label: Experimental · 150 mm/s command · 5 ms preview
profiles.readiness: Experimental faster gait with slipping. Preview accuracy and realtime performance are being measured.
profiles.evidence: Detailed 20 s / 0.625 ms run: 154.6–155.0 mm/s, 11.55% loaded-foot slip, 150/150 planned lifts; no sampled inter-leg overlap. This 5 ms numerical preview has separate accuracy and browser checks. Provisional actuator model and ideal observations; no hardware speed claim.
